Security review details
**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The directly affected population is callers selecting Vertex or OpenRouter without an explicit model. Their submitted skill content reaches a different inference target within the existing provider route. Source inspection establishes no new credential scope, caller authority, or tool-execution capability; deployment-specific tenant exposure is not supplied. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — The existing path treats package content as evidence in a user message alongside a separate security-analysis system message, then parses and validates the returned analysis. The PR preserves these controls; their presence does not establish equivalent resistance to adversarial content across the old and replacement inference targets. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — The pre-existing analysis failure path records last_error and returns an informational LLM_ANALYSIS_FAILED finding stating that semantic analysis did not complete. This provides local failure visibility if a replacement request or response fails, but does not prove how downstream consumers enforce incomplete-scan handling.
